## Licensed runtime
Production API: https://uipojzbnnfifsbkivxoh.supabase.co/functions/v1/cie-api
Production MCP: https://uipojzbnnfifsbkivxoh.supabase.co/functions/v1/cie-mcp
API Marketplace SKU: CT-API-CIE-V1

CIE structures identity, narrative, audience, voice, representation constraints, cultural commitments, goals, guardrails, rights context, routing and evidence across products, media, commerce, advertising, licensing, analytics and AI.

The public conformance engine demonstrates HOLD, WARN and PASS. HOLD stops release in the public workflow and returns remediation. WARN keeps an asset draft-only and marks review required. PASS permits only the next separately authorized stage. Public surfaces do not use protected CrownThrive calibration and have no provider-write, payment, ad-spend or persistence authority.

## Publishing
Eight free CIE take-home packets are published as Go Flipbooks Standard editions and also available as direct PDFs. Go Flipbooks is the durable publication/reader surface; the CIE website is the live engine.

## Commerce
Operator $299; Studio $799; Agency $2,499; Institutional $4,999; Enterprise $7,500. Production API/MCP and the PentaAds bridge begin at Studio. Resale, sublicensing, white-label and OEM rights require an applicable signed CrownThrive addendum.
